name: Arena - Default (seed v1)
description: A duel arena: its place, region and exit, and the duel settings players negotiate within. Every setting starts at the design default. Its battlegrounds, spectator areas and lobby are its own areas (not domains), added on the last step once the arena is saved.

steps.description: Name the arena, place it and capture its region and locations. Duels stay off until the lobby location is set.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown to players in menus and announcements.

fields.label: Key
fields.description: Short unique id for commands and config, e.g. arena_2. Letters, digits and _ . , - only.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: One line for admins and the web app, e.g. what the arena is used for.

fields.label: District
fields.description: The district the arena stands in. Its region is the arena region's parent.

fields.label: Street
fields.description: The street the arena is on. Use Create New if the street isn't there yet.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The WorldGuard region around the whole arena (its lobby, battlegrounds and spectator areas inside it). Use Send to Minecraft, or type an existing region's name such as arena_2.

fields.label: Allow entry
fields.description: Players may walk into the arena. Battlegrounds have their own rule.

fields.label: Allow exit
fields.description: Players inside the arena may walk out of it.

fields.label: Spawn point
fields.description: Optional: where /warp and /navigate <arena> spawn put players.

fields.label: Exit location
fields.description: Where duelists go after the match. Leave empty for the spawn point.

fields.label: Duels enabled
fields.description: Players can challenge each other here. Needs an enabled lobby area with an arrival location: save the arena with this off, add the lobby on the last step, then turn it on.

steps.description: How invitations are negotiated and what may be staked.

fields.label: Offers per negotiation
fields.description: 1-6. Offer 1 is the inviter's, each later one a counter; the last can only be accepted or declined. 2 = offer and one counter.

fields.label: Seconds per offer
fields.description: How long each side has to answer an offer.

fields.label: Allow coin stakes
fields.description: Players may stake coins.

fields.label: Allow item stakes
fields.description: Players may stake items from their inventory.

fields.label: Maximum coin stake
fields.description: Per side.

fields.label: Maximum item stacks
fields.description: Per side.

fields.label: Minimum stake ratio (%)
fields.description: 0-100. The smaller coin stake must be at least this % of the larger; 0 = off. Stops one-sided stakes that move coins.

fields.label: Arena fee (%)
fields.description: 0-20. Taken from the coin pot of a decisive result, never on draws, cancels or friendly duels.

steps.description: Who may stake, and limits that make thrown duels pointless. Empty eligibility fields follow the /pay rules.

fields.label: Minimum account age (hours)
fields.description: Optional. Empty = the /pay minimum (currency policy, 48 hours).

fields.label: Minimum title
fields.description: Optional. Empty = the /pay minimum title.

fields.label: Staked duels per pair per day
fields.description: The same two players can't play more staked duels than this in a day.

fields.label: Pair cooldown (minutes)
fields.description: Between staked duels of the same two players.

fields.label: Daily coin win cap
fields.description: Per player per day; 0 = off.

steps.description: Which gear modes a proposal may pick. Allow at least one; the kit modes need eligible kits on the next step.

fields.label: Own gear, keep inventory
fields.description: Duelists fight with their own gear and keep it on death.

fields.label: Own gear, loser drops
fields.description: The loser's inventory goes to the winner. High stakes; both duelists must be eligible to stake.

fields.label: Fixed kit
fields.description: Both duelists use the kit the proposal names; their own inventory is stored and given back.

fields.label: Kit choice
fields.description: Each duelist picks one of the eligible kits in the warmup.

fields.label: Default gear mode
fields.description: Pre-selected in a new proposal; must be one of the allowed modes.

steps.description: The kits for the fixed-kit and kit-choice modes. Add each with Create New Join Entry and drag to order; the first is the default pick.

fields.label: Eligible kits
fields.description: One entry per kit.

steps.description: How long each phase lasts, and how many accepted matches may wait for a battleground.

fields.label: Queued matches
fields.description: Accepted matches not yet in a battleground (travelling, warmup, waiting). The next accept is refused at this number.

fields.label: Warmup (seconds)
fields.description: In the lobby before the countdown.

fields.label: Countdown (seconds)
fields.description: Frozen on the spawn before the fight.

fields.label: Fight time limit (seconds)
fields.description: At the limit the match is a draw with a full refund. 0 = no limit (players can agree a draw).

fields.label: Maximum wait (seconds)
fields.description: Waiting for a free battleground, then the match is cancelled and refunded.

fields.label: Winner linger (seconds)
fields.description: How long the winner stays in the battleground before the exit teleport.

steps.description: What the server is told about matches in this arena.

fields.label: Announce matches
fields.description: Broadcast the warmup with [Spectate] [Details], and the result.

fields.label: Announce friendly duels
fields.description: Also announce duels without stakes.

steps.description: The arena's areas (rev. 6: its own sub-structure, not domains) and the arena's own extra regions. Save the arena first (Submit), then Edit it to add them; each area has its own form with its regions.

fields.label: Areas
fields.description: Battlegrounds (one match each), spectator areas and the lobby (one per arena), each with its regions.

fields.label: Sub-regions
fields.description: KNG-253: extra regions of the arena itself (the arena is their union with its main region), copies of the main region.

validationRules.errorMessage: The arena's region is not completely inside the district's region.
